hello_ai.welcome_message: Hello! I'm Hello AI, a demo plugin for Klytos. Type anything and I'll respond. Try saying hello!
hello_ai.response_1: Hello! Great to see you here. Klytos is an amazing CMS!
hello_ai.response_2: Hi there! Did you know this plugin was discovered by its PHP header? No JSON needed!
hello_ai.response_3: Hey! I'm a demo plugin running on the immutable plugin contract.
hello_ai.response_4: Greetings! The plugin system of Klytos is inspired by WordPress but built for the AI era.
hello_ai.response_5: Hello, human! I live in plugins/hello-ai/hello-ai.php and that's all Klytos needs to find me.
hello_ai.response_6: Hi! Fun fact: my entire identification is just "Plugin Name: Hello AI" in a PHP comment.
hello_ai.response_7: Hey there! I'm proof that Klytos plugins can be as simple or as complex as you want.
hello_ai.response_8: Hello! This plugin supports multiple languages. Try switching to Spanish!
hello_ai.smart_hello: Hello! Nice to meet you. I'm a Klytos plugin demo.
hello_ai.smart_hi: Hi there! Welcome to Hello AI.
hello_ai.smart_klytos: Klytos is an AI-First CMS controlled via MCP. Pretty cool, right?
hello_ai.smart_plugin: Plugins in Klytos just need a PHP file with a "Plugin Name:" header. Simple!
hello_ai.smart_mcp: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is how AI assistants talk to Klytos. It's the future!
hello_ai.smart_help: I'm just a demo, but the real AI chat is in AI-Mode. Try it!
hello_ai.smart_bye: Goodbye! Thanks for trying Hello AI. See you next time!
hello_ai.smart_translate: This plugin uses klytos_register_translations() and the __() function for i18n. Check the lang/ folder!
